capabilities.name: Constitution & Governance
capabilities.purpose: Constitutional constraints, owner gates, and principle authority for the platform.
capabilities.next_action: Preserve owner approval gates and keep constitutional checks explicit.

capabilities.name: Source Intelligence
capabilities.purpose: Discover, verify, and publish trusted source coverage and lifecycle state.

blocking_issues.exact_blocker: Approved sources are not fully integrated and Florida state sources remain partially blocked.

capabilities.next_action: Complete the remaining approved source integrations and unblock market build coverage.

capabilities.name: Market Builder
capabilities.purpose: Prepare reusable market-specific canonical build runs and validation bundles.

blocking_issues.exact_blocker: No generic builder entry point exists; validation remains state-specific.

capabilities.next_action: Build the generic market-builder entry point and keep validation reusable across markets.

capabilities.name: Canonical Universe
capabilities.purpose: Normalize, deduplicate, and publish canonical facility identities and crosswalks.

blocking_issues.exact_blocker: Layer 2 Market Builder remains state-specific and Nevada HCQC remains unintegrated.

capabilities.next_action: Finish the remaining market-builder dependency chain and close the Nevada HCQC gap.

capabilities.name: Government Identity
capabilities.purpose: Resolve legal names, NPI links, state identity, and crosswalks for canonical facilities.

blocking_issues.exact_blocker: Government identity resolution still depends on incomplete canonical universe coverage.

capabilities.next_action: Finish identity crosswalk coverage once canonical universe completeness is settled.

capabilities.name: Media Intelligence
capabilities.purpose: Verify facility images and media identity without letting generic media become evidence.

blocking_issues.exact_blocker: Rights validation is not integrated for the media pilot and generic media remains non-facility-specific.

capabilities.next_action: Complete rights validation and media pilot gating before expanding image coverage.

capabilities.name: Knowledge Graph
capabilities.purpose: Link knowledge objects into an explainable, deduplicated platform graph.
capabilities.next_action: Maintain graph integrity and orphan detection while upstream sources continue maturing.

capabilities.name: Data Quality & Trust
capabilities.purpose: Protect freshness, provenance, and conflict resolution across prepared knowledge.
capabilities.next_action: Continue freshness and conflict monitoring across all prepared knowledge objects.

capabilities.name: Matching Improvement
capabilities.purpose: Apply validated ranking-policy improvements and guardrails.
capabilities.next_action: Keep ranking policy guardrails aligned with validated traces and outcomes.

capabilities.name: Provider Intelligence
capabilities.purpose: Discover and verify provider capabilities so recommendations use prepared provider intelligence.
capabilities.next_action: Continue controlled discovery and publish only verified provider updates.

capabilities.name: Activities Intelligence
capabilities.purpose: Publish verified activities and engagement intelligence that improves lifestyle fit recommendations.
capabilities.next_action: Keep publishing verified activities intelligence and close stale content gaps.

capabilities.name: Clinical Knowledge
capabilities.purpose: Discover and validate trusted clinical guidance for care-fit recommendations.
capabilities.next_action: Continue validating care-fit guidance against prepared evidence.

capabilities.name: Clinical Evidence
capabilities.purpose: Attach trusted evidence to clinical and recommendation claims.

blocking_issues.exact_blocker: Automated external evidence monitoring is not configured.

capabilities.next_action: Automate evidence monitoring and close the external evidence gap.

capabilities.name: Narrative Intelligence
capabilities.purpose: Produce advisor-ready explanations and trust-clarity narratives from prepared knowledge.

blocking_issues.exact_blocker: Upstream evidence and knowledge coverage remain insufficient for fully trusted narratives.

capabilities.next_action: Complete the explanation-quality pipeline once upstream evidence coverage is stronger.

capabilities.name: Nutrition Intelligence
capabilities.purpose: Discover and verify dietary support capabilities for nutrition and allergy needs.
capabilities.next_action: Keep nutrition evidence fresh and close unsupported dietary gaps.

capabilities.name: Outcome Learning
capabilities.purpose: Transform outcome signals into prepared knowledge that improves fit, safety, and quality.
capabilities.next_action: Keep outcome calibration aligned with verified traces and facts.

capabilities.name: Resident Needs Intelligence
capabilities.purpose: Model resident needs and constraints for fit and safety.
capabilities.next_action: Keep resident-need modeling aligned with structured evidence inputs.

capabilities.name: Senior Living Research
capabilities.purpose: Produce verified senior living research summaries and knowledge signals.
capabilities.next_action: Keep research summaries aligned with verified source intelligence.

capabilities.name: Family Experience Intelligence
capabilities.purpose: Convert prepared knowledge into family-ready guidance and trust clarity.
capabilities.next_action: Keep family guidance consistent with verified evidence and uncertainty visibility.

capabilities.name: Assessment Experience
capabilities.purpose: Own the family assessment journey and collect decision-relevant preferences.
capabilities.next_action: Preserve the governed assessment flow and keep advice explainable.

capabilities.name: Recommendation Decision Engine
capabilities.purpose: Convert prepared knowledge and assessment inputs into governed recommendations.

blocking_issues.exact_blocker: Upstream canonical universe and assessment readiness remain incomplete for full production confidence.

capabilities.next_action: Keep recommendation logic unchanged while upstream readiness is completed.

capabilities.name: Chief AI Supervisor
capabilities.purpose: Coordinate incidents, scheduler cycles, readiness, and publication readiness.

blocking_issues.exact_blocker: Owner email delivery remains blocked by missing SMTP configuration.

capabilities.next_action: Keep the supervisor operating, but do not claim full production readiness while email is blocked.

capabilities.name: Remediation Policy Engine
capabilities.purpose: Select bounded allowlisted remediation actions for known failure types.
capabilities.next_action: Maintain allowlisted recovery behavior and keep execution bounded.

capabilities.name: Email Delivery
capabilities.purpose: Send owner-facing reports through the canonical SMTP path.

blocking_issues.exact_blocker: OPTIME_SMTP_HOST and OPTIME_SMTP_FROM are missing from environment configuration.

capabilities.next_action: Provide SMTP configuration and confirm delivery acceptance.

capabilities.name: Report Archive
capabilities.purpose: Persist and version report artifacts and sent-status records.
capabilities.next_action: Keep the archive canonical and idempotent for daily reporting.

capabilities.name: Runtime Sync
capabilities.purpose: Track schema drift and keep runtime metadata aligned with the live database.
capabilities.next_action: Continue runtime schema alignment and drift monitoring.

capabilities.name: Daily System Health Report
capabilities.purpose: Generate the canonical daily owner report and capture delivery state.

blocking_issues.exact_blocker: SMTP delivery is blocked by missing required environment variables.

capabilities.next_action: Keep report generation canonical while email remains blocked by configuration.

capabilities.name: Platform Registry
capabilities.purpose: Canonical inventory of platform capabilities, dependencies, readiness, and business progress.
capabilities.next_action: Keep the registry synchronized to the latest verified evidence and supervisor state.
